findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Time-of-check time-of-use race condition
 * @description Checking file existence before operating on it can lead to race conditions
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/toctou-race-condition
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-367
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode check, DataFlow::CallCfgNode use
where
  // File existence checks
  (
    check = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("path").getMember(["exists", "isfile", "isdir"]).getACall() or
    check = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getReturn().getMember(["exists", "is_file", "is_dir"]).getACall()
  ) and
  // File operations that follow
  (
    use = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["remove", "unlink", "rmdir", "rename"]).getACall() or
    use = API::builtin("open").getACall() or
    use = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getReturn().getMember(["unlink", "rmdir", "rename"]).getACall()
  )
select check, "Potential TOCTOU race condition: file existence check may be followed by file operation."
findings.hypothesis: Check for Time-of-Check-Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) race conditions where file existence is checked before use

message.text: Potential TOCTOU race condition: file existence check may be followed by file operation.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Symlink following in file operations
 * @description File operations that follow symbolic links without validation can be exploited
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/symlink-following
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-059
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    // open() without O_NOFOLLOW
    call = API::builtin("open").getACall() or
    // os.open without O_NOFOLLOW flag
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("open").getACall() or
    // Path operations that may follow symlinks
    call = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getReturn().getMember(["exists", "is_file", "is_dir", "stat", "lstat", "unlink", "rmdir"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["stat", "lstat", "remove", "unlink", "rmdir"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("path").getMember(["exists", "isfile", "isdir"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "File operation that may follow symbolic links without proper validation."
findings.hypothesis: Symlink attacks where file operations follow symbolic links without proper validation, potentially allowing attackers to manipulate file locks or access unintended files

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure file permissions on lock files
 * @description Lock files created with overly permissive permissions may allow unauthorized access
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/insecure-lock-file-permissions
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-732
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    // Check for os.open without O_EXCL or proper mode
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("open").getACall() or
    // Check for open() calls without proper mode specification
    call = API::builtin("open").getACall()
  ) and
  // In filelock module files
  call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("%filelock%")
select call, "File operation may create lock file with insecure permissions."
findings.hypothesis: Check for insecure file permissions when creating lock files that could allow unauthorized access
